name: vue
description: Vue 3 Composition API + Vite SPA (no SSR) + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Vue Router + Pinia

notes.serverCode: An SPA has no server runtime — the backend axis owns server logic entirely. If the backend is a BaaS, the browser calls the SDK directly, so data-layer security (row-level policy) is the only boundary
notes.language: The default is TypeScript. Pick JavaScript and the type-standard slot is replaced by JSDoc conventions, and `<script setup lang="ts">` becomes `<script setup>`
notes.reactivity: Reactivity differs from React — ref/reactive are proxy-based, so destructuring breaks reactivity and a missing `.value` becomes a silent failure. This is the point where an axis-specific misuse list is needed
notes.guideShape: Same shape as react-vite in having no server runtime — it shares the seam slot set (data fetching · auth/session · full examples) and the 'the data layer is the only boundary' wording. Nuxt is a separate axis (server runtime built in)
